fast.why: Thursday is a day deeds are presented to Allah. Plan your sahur or make niyyah before Zuhr if you haven't eaten since Subuh.

blessing: Family: someone at home or on the phone who worries about you and makes du'a for you. Today, call or message one family member with a sincere thank-you, and say 'Alhamdulillah' for them after Maghrib.

verse.text: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favour].

hadith.text: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all his affairs are good. If he is given ease he is grateful, and that is good for him; if hardship touches him he is patient, and that is good for him.

lesson.title: Seerah: Khadijah (RA) comforts the Prophet ﷺ
lesson.text: After the first revelation in Cave Hira, the Prophet ﷺ returned trembling. Khadijah (RA) reassured him: 'Never! Allah will never disgrace you. You keep good ties, bear the burden of the weak, help the needy and assist those in hardship.' Lesson: steady, kind character and a supportive companion carry us through fear, and we should be that support for others too.

name.text: "Indeed my Lord is Guardian over all things" (11:57). He guards you, your family and your deeds, even when you are too busy to notice.
"Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins" (39:53). Close the day with istighfar and sleep lightly.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
